title: Validator flags reading load and unsafe claims on a weak draft
turnSequence: The same strong draft is mutated: variant 0 instructions grow past 30 words (Grade 4 reading-load heuristic) and variant 1 title gains an unsafe claim.
reviewLearningQuality runs again on the mutated draft.
expected: The review returns verdict hard_block with a READING_LEVEL_TOO_COMPLEX warning on the long instructions (Grade 4 word cap) and an UNSAFE_CLAIM hard block on the unsafe copy, each naming field, variant, reason, and recommendation — the app identifies what to double-check without claiming it verified the lesson.
observableFailure: The weak draft passes the validator, or findings lose the field/reason/recommendation the teacher needs to act on.
